cases.name: matches on a snapshot's parent state value
cases.test: match.test.ts > matches() method > should execute matchesState on a State given the parent state value

excluded.reason: pure value tests of matchesState(parentStateValue, childStateValue) with no machine, ported one row per expect() (24 rows) as match_rows in test/xstate/values_test.cpp (xstate-values), which calls xstate::matches_state on the test's own values; a case could reach matchesState only through a query's snapshot.matches(v), whose child is a machine's snapshot value and so never a dotted string path such as 'b.b1' or 'a.b', which 7 of the 24 rows pass as the child
